question:
In the following question, select the related letter pair from the given alternatives.

WZC : XAD :: ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

WZC : XAD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9662badd18d75e32d561d92fbade31f746371816c84aa7e2a295cc8865a785a1.png] 

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) CGK : DHL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d3a3e554d901ab53996179c0d16cf53fc7842b9d75f96b70a9755a0c969f1ae.png] 

Option 2) PPV : VUL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57ef4f50e83acb9207e2a4dfb9ca7abacb8b04723f87431e923ca0810da49521.png] 

Option 3) HAV : BUX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/790055c7a75cfd8df4fc1a1698ac7309d4fb455e0539e2a58fbbe60441010b53.png] 

Option 4) ABB : BZU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6abe0de686caa6bfe17cb77d302992afba684645747610d0184acb6ac8c9820.png] 

Thus, out of all the options, 'CGK : DHL' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
